fields.value: Replication Data for: Do consumers benefit from national‑brand listings by hard discounters?

dsDescriptionValue.value: This replication package contains scripts to replicate the results of a study that quantifies the consumer-welfare impact of adding a select set of leading national brands to hard discounter Lidl’s assortment in the German market. Please refer the published paper for a description of how these program files should be read and used in the analysis. Proprietary GfK panel data from Germany are not included in the package because the company's NDA agreement does not allow this.

publicationCitation.value: Geyskens, I., Deleersnyder, B., Dekimpe, M.G. et al. Do consumers benefit from national-brand listings by hard discounters?. J. of the Acad. Mark. Sci. 52, 97–118 (2024).

fields.value: Proprietary secondary data from GfK; data sharing is prohibited through an NDA (Contact person AiMark: Alfred Dijs, COO - Alfred.Dijs@aimark.org)
